2. Methodological Transparency and Rigor
The Methods section has been substantially expanded to clarify the qualitative document
analysis procedures. We now explicitly explain the inclusion and exclusion criteria for
document selection, the strategies used to assess source credibility, and the analytical steps
employed, including categorization, thematic comparison, and triangulation across policy
documents, implementation reports, and academic literature. Furthermore, we have
strengthened the academic basis for selecting the five analytical dimensions by directly
linking them to the reviewed theory and previous empirical findings.



3. Clarity and Replicability
Revisions were also made to improve clarity, coherence, and transparency throughout the
manuscript to support interpretive validity and facilitate replication by other researchers.
